domain.description: Authentication domain name. Must match across all MUNGE nodes in a cluster for interoperability.

key_file.description: Path to the secret key file used for HMAC authentication. Must be identical on all nodes in the cluster.

num_threads.description: Number of worker threads to spawn for handling authentication requests.

cred_cache_size.description: Maximum number of credentials to cache per MUNGE daemon process.

cred_cache_max.description: Maximum total number of credentials to cache system-wide. Set to 0 for unlimited.

cred_cache_ttl.description: Time-to-live (in seconds) for cached credentials before they expire.

log_level.description: Verbosity level for logging. Accepts: DEBUG, INFO, NOTICE, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL, ALERT, EMERGENCY.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Use 'syslog' to send logs to the system log daemon instead.

local_only.description: If true, only allow authentication requests from the local host. Disables network authentication.

keygen.description: If true, automatically generate a new RSA key file on first start if the key file does not exist.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file used by the daemon.

restrict_groups.description: Comma- or space-separated list of group IDs (numeric or named) allowed to use the service. Empty = no restriction.

restrict_users.description: Comma- or space-separated list of user IDs (numeric or named) allowed to use the service. Empty = no restriction.

socket_auth.description: Enable or disable socket-based authentication for local processes.

socket_path.description: Unix socket path used for local interprocess communication.
